item.title: Network & K8s.04-1 One IP per Room
item.description: The Kubernetes network model read from the room up — why a Pod gets one IP and shares it across containers, the three rules every CNI must satisfy and where NAT still lives, how a Pod IP is born in two steps and dies only with the Pod, what kubelet actually does when it probes, and the /24-vs-/32 choice that decides whether the host sees every packet.
